title: Page through search results
hints: A slice `items[start:stop]` never raises, even when `stop` is past the end. It just stops early, or gives `[]`.
Page 1 starts at index 0, page 2 at index `per_page`, so a page starts at `(page - 1) * per_page`.
Check `if page < 1 or per_page < 1: raise ValueError("must be at least 1")`, then `start = (page - 1) * per_page` and `return items[start:start + per_page]`.
